description: Monotonic descending sweep of learned positional factorization ranks below the retained rank-8 representation.
proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: accepted attempt-0012 at learned positional rank 8 (3430, 99.66%); earlier attempt-0001's fixed sinusoidal substitution was an optimization failure; 2 prior family attempts. Hypothesis: the retained learned factorization may tolerate lower positional rank because fixed-format addition positions share structured roles. This is a representational factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. Ordering: test ranks 6, 4, 2, 1 in descending order. Acceptance/rollback: the runner retains only qualified smaller candidates and restores the incumbent otherwise; any scored discard/error stops the lower-rank branch because it changes the declared monotonic eligibility rule. Stopping: first discard/error, no eligible ranks, or four micro-trials. Maximum micro-trials: 4. Compute budget: at most 120000 training steps and four configured runner windows (14400 seconds); all training, verification, retention, and recording run exclusively through run_attempt.py. This is more informative than skipping to rank 4 because rank 6 is the nearest untested learned-rank boundary.
summary: Attempted learned positional rank 6 from retained rank 8; the single micro-trial completed 30000 training steps in about 9.4 minutes, plateaued at 10.25% validation, produced no checkpoint, and received no official score. No candidate was retained; the frontier remains rank 8 at 3430 parameters and 99.660000%. Stopped because the recorded optimization-failure error changed the declared monotonic lower-rank eligibility rule, as recorded in AUTOMATION_TRIGGER.json.
